heading: Why shop with Northwind
intro: Small workshops, honest materials and service that outlasts the order.

items.title: Free shipping over $80
items.text: Carbon-neutral delivery across the US in 2 to 4 business days.

items.title: 60-day returns
items.text: Changed your mind? Send it back unworn or unused for a full refund.

items.title: Repairs for life
items.text: We darn, re-glaze and re-handle anything we make, free of charge.

items.title: Traceable materials
items.text: Every product page names the farm, mill or clay pit it came from.
